Hi, I\'m Painty! I\'m always here while you draw. Tap me and I\'ll give you a tip.
Pick the paint bucket, pick a color and tap a shape: the spot you tap gets painted!
Hold your finger on a shape for 2 seconds and the whole shape gets painted at once.
Oops? The back arrow at the top undoes your last step.
Add a house or balloons from the ready pictures and paint them any way you like.
Have you tried changing the paper color? It can be blue like the sky!
That looks great! You draw so well.
Super! Keep going, you\'re doing great!

Want to finish your drawing like a %1$s? I\'ll add %2$d parts!
Let\'s draw with Painty
Painty shows you the tools and makes a picture with you step by step.
Hello!
I\'m Painty! I\'ll show you the drawing tools and we\'ll make a big picture together. Ready?
Brush
With the brush you draw anything you like. Look, I\'m drawing a bright sun in the sky!
Ready pictures
The shape button adds ready pictures. I\'m putting in a house and colorful balloons.
Paint bucket
Pick the bucket, pick a color and tap inside a shape: the spot you tap gets painted. A red roof and a yellow wall!
Paint it all
Hold your finger on a shape for 2 seconds: when the ring fills up, the whole shape is painted. All the balloons are pink!
Eraser
The eraser wipes away lines you don\'t want. I\'m erasing this scribble.
Undo
Something went wrong? The back arrow undoes your last step, the forward arrow does it again.
Paper color
You can change the paper color too. I\'m making it sky blue!
All done!
Finally, some green grass! Our picture is ready. Now it\'s your turn, make the most beautiful picture!
